{{Quote|It is indeed. An Arakyd Mark Two, to be precise. An old one, as you say, and not in the best of shape. The repulsor drive no longer works, but the sensors are still functional.|Lord Odo|<ref name="COO" />}}
The '''Mark Two seeker''' was a [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|seeker]]-type [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] small enough to fit in a humanoid hand and travel through the life support ducts of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="COO" />
